title: AI Agent Weekly #1: YC Bets on Agent Infrastructure

sections.title: 🔥 Top Story
sections.content: **YC S24 backs Voker — analytics for AI agents.** Silicon Valley's top incubator is betting that 'agent infrastructure' is the next big category. Voker provides monitoring, analytics, and debugging for AI agent deployments — similar to what Datadog did for servers. This signals a market shift: from building agents to managing them at scale.

sections.title: 💡 Business Model Spotlight
sections.content: **Agent Templates are the new SaaS.** Instead of building custom AI agents from scratch, companies are buying pre-built templates for specific industries (real estate, e-commerce, customer support). The template model mirrors WordPress themes in 2010 — early entrants capture the market. Our analysis: 5 verticals ready for disruption.

sections.title: 🤑 Monetization Tip
sections.content: **Sell the workflow, not the tool.** The most successful AI products in 2026 don't sell AI features — they sell complete workflows. Example: 'Real Estate Lead Qualifier' sells better than 'AI Text Generator'. Package your prompt + integration guide + sample outputs into a complete solution and charge 3x more.
